parts.name: SettingRow
parts.description: A label/value layout with an optional trailing action. Native div attributes and ref apply to the row wrapper.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value or editable content displayed beneath the label.

props.name: action
props.description: Optional trailing action/control, such as a button or switch.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.
